prompt: In a vibrant anime style illustration, the interior of a bustling fire station is depicted with precise clarity. On the far left, a firefighter in a yellow helmet stands firmly next to a shiny red fire truck, holding a coiled hose. Beside him, a small brown dog sits attentively, looking up at the firefighter's boots. In the center foreground, a woman in a blue uniform points toward a large digital clock on the wall, drawing the attention of a man in a gray suit who is looking at her gesture. Next to the man in the gray suit, a child in a striped shirt holds a toy fireman, gazing at the real equipment with wide eyes. Behind them, an older man in a white shirt leans against a metal locker, observing the scene with a calm expression. To the right, two firefighters in orange gear are handing a heavy axe to a rookie in a green jacket, who is reaching out to take it. Above this group, a black cat perches on a high shelf, watching the activity below with narrowed eyes. Near the back wall, a mechanic in oily overalls is working on a spare tire, while a nurse in a pink scrub top stands next to him, holding a clipboard. A parrot in a colorful cage hangs from the ceiling near the center, squawking silently. On a bench to the right, a teenager in a hoodie is sitting on the edge, tying their shoelaces. A coffee mug rests on a nearby table, steam rising from it. There is no smoke in the air, and there is no fire visible anywhere in the station. The scene captures a moment of daily routine rather than emergency, with each character distinct in their attire and action. The firefighter in the yellow helmet remains stationary, anchoring the left side of the composition. The woman in the blue uniform maintains her pointing pose, directing focus. The man in the gray suit turns his head slightly to follow her finger. The child in the striped shirt clutches the toy tightly. The older man in the white shirt keeps his arms crossed. The two firefighters in orange gear coordinate their lift. The rookie in the green jacket extends both hands. The black cat remains still on the shelf. The mechanic in oily overalls bends over the tire. The nurse in the pink scrub top checks her list. The parrot in the colorful cage tilts its head. The teenager in the hoodie focuses on their feet. The coffee mug sits undisturbed. The small brown dog wags its tail slightly. The shiny red fire truck reflects the overhead lights. The large digital clock displays the time clearly.
